title: Baby in High Chair in Backyard, 1960 B&W Snapshot
description: A classic June 1960 black-and-white square snapshot depicting a baby in a high chair in a grassy suburban backyard. The toddler appears to have food on their face and high chair tray. In the background, a lawn table set is visible along with another child sitting near a cinder block wall fence. The photo margin carries a photofinishing date stamp 'JUN 60'.
